explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/400: is there c_k such that for almost all n < x, g_k(n) = c_k log x + o(log x)? Here g_k(n) is the max of (a₁+⋯+a_k) - n over a₁!⋯a_k! | n!. The statement asserts, for each k ≥ 2, some c such that for every ε > 0 the proportion of n ≤ x with |g_k(n) - c log x| ≤ ε log x tends to 1. That is the standard 'almost all' reading. Faithful.
